name: sparse_join
sql: SELECT b.id FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.boxes b ON b.b && p.q

name: medium_join
sql: SELECT b.id FROM (SELECT * FROM s2.probes WHERE id<=64) p JOIN s2.boxes b ON b.b && box(center(p.q),center(p.q)+point(20,20))

name: absent_join
sql: SELECT b.id FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.boxes b ON b.b && box(point(2000+p.id,2000),point(2000+p.id,2000))

name: single_sparse
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.boxes WHERE b && box(point(100,100),point(105,105))

name: allmatch_natural
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.boxes WHERE b && box(point(-1,-1),point(2000,2000))

name: saturated_natural
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.saturated WHERE b && '((0,0),(0,0))'::box

name: tiny_natural
sql: SELECT b.id FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.tiny b ON b.b && p.q

name: point_off
sql: SELECT b.id FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.points b ON b.p <@ p.q

name: custom_fn_off
sql: SELECT b.id FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.wrapped b ON b.b && p.q

name: two_keys_off
sql: SELECT b.id FROM s2.probes p JOIN s2.boxes b ON b.b && p.q AND b.b @> center(p.q)

name: null_off
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.boxes WHERE b IS NULL

name: edge_0
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.edges WHERE b && '((0,0),(0,0))'::box

name: edge_1
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.edges WHERE b && '((0.000001,0),(0.000001,0))'::box

name: edge_2
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.edges WHERE b && '((NaN,0),(NaN,0))'::box

name: edge_3
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.edges WHERE b && '((Infinity,Infinity),(-Infinity,-Infinity))'::box

name: edge_4
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.edges WHERE b && '((Infinity,Infinity),(Infinity,Infinity))'::box

name: edge_5
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.edges WHERE b && '((-Infinity,-Infinity),(-Infinity,-Infinity))'::box

name: searchnotnull
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.boxes WHERE b IS NOT NULL

name: nullarg
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.boxes WHERE b && NULL::box

name: containedoff
sql: SELECT id FROM s2.boxes WHERE b <@ '((100,100),(0,0))'::box
